properties.description: The catalogue of gap sources detect_gaps raises, one row per source: what each detects, why it exists, what it deliberately excludes and what it cannot see. Its decision_overtaken_by_promotion row states the condition the detector reads, which since 2026-10-13 is the shared reading of "arrived" in crates/reflow2-core/src/arrival.rs.
